ABSTRACT_TEXT: This thesis designs, implements, and evaluates QuantVN Strategy Forge, a web-based quantitative analysis platform for Vietnamese equities listed on the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange (HOSE). The platform addresses the gap in accessible quantitative tools for Vietnamese retail investors by integrating stock screening, strategy backtesting with five strategy types, portfolio optimisation using four methods (Mean-Variance, Risk Parity, Minimum Variance, Maximum Sharpe), risk management metrics (VaR, CVaR, drawdown), factor analysis, and an AI assistant grounded in the platform's own computations. The system covers approximately 500 HOSE-listed stocks with daily data from 2018 to 2025. The AI assistant employs retrieval-augmented generation with policy-gated abstention to prevent unsupported financial claims. Results demonstrate the platform successfully provides integrated quantitative analysis capabilities comparable to international tools while supporting Vietnamese market conventions including transaction costs, daily price limits, and settlement cycles.
